text.arabic_uthmani: الٓمٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ۗ وَٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

words.gloss_range: disconnected recited letters; a threshold before ordinary clause grammar begins
words.prose: {{ar:المر}} ({{tr:alif-lām-mīm-rā}}) opens before the ayah enters ordinary grammar. The letters are recited as a controlled threshold: opaque, non-lexical, and in some readings audibly segmented letter by letter. The added ra makes this opener part of the known letter-opening system while marking Surah 13 as formally distinct within that family.

topics.headline: pre-syntactic letter threshold
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the surah begins with recited letters before ordinary parsing starts.
topics.reason: QAC treats the opener as disconnected letters without root, case, or government, and the next nominal clause begins only with the demonstrative.

topics.headline: letter-by-letter recitation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opacity as separated recited units, not as a fused lexical word.
topics.reason: The qiraat and form rows preserve pause-separated letter naming while leaving the non-lexical parse intact.

topics.headline: marked ra extension
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this opener belongs to the known letter-opening system while its added ra marks this surah distinctly.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows identify this exact four-letter alif-lam-mim-ra form as distributionally marked against other alif-lam-mim openings and adjacent ra-bearing opener families.

words.gloss_range: distal feminine demonstrative pointing into the book-sign declaration
words.prose: {{ar:تِلْكَ}} ({{tr:tilka}}) starts the first explicit predication after the letters, pointing to the following sign-plural rather than to the Book alone. Its distal form gives the referent elevation, and its position turns opacity into declaration: those are the Book-bound signs.

topics.headline: demonstrative predication and agreement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the pointer as the subject of a nominal identification and as aimed at the sign-plural, not at the Book alone.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the demonstrative the subject of the nominal clause and links it cataphorically to the following feminine plural sign phrase.

topics.headline: distal elevation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices reverential distance built into the pointing itself.
topics.reason: The distal demonstrative is locally coherent as elevated or remote deixis while still pointing into the following phrase.

topics.headline: hinge from opacity to declaration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from opaque letters into identified signs.
topics.reason: The demonstrative comes immediately after the disconnected letters and before the book-sign predicate, so it functions as the transition into explicit declaration.

words.gloss_range: book-bound signs, verses, proofs, or markers presented as countable evidence-units
words.root_gloss_range: sign, verse, proof, marker, and known indicator; refuge or return pressure is only a disputed background coloring
words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَٰتُ}} ({{tr:āyātu}}) names the pointed referent as signs in construct with the Book, so the evidence is book-bound rather than free-floating. The word keeps sign, verse, proof, and marker together, while disputed refuge or return pressure remains only a secondary reference-point image. Its noun-only profile makes the signs given countable realities, and the phrase joins repeated opening formulas (10:1; 12:1; 15:1; 26:2; 27:1; 28:2; 31:2) while beginning a local sign thread (13:2; 13:7; 13:27; 13:38).

topics.headline: signs bound to the Book
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the signs are not free-floating evidences but signs belonging to one Book-domain.
topics.reason: The idafa relation is syntactically forced: the sign plural is the construct head and the definite Book is its genitive complement.

topics.headline: sign, proof, and marker range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the evidentiary force of signs, verses, proofs, and markers instead of flattening the word to verses alone.
topics.reason: The local noun supports sign and proof range; the disputed refuge or return evidence can color reference-point imagery but does not replace the selected sign sense.

topics.headline: given noun evidence-units
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the signs are presented as existing countable realities, not as actions being performed.
topics.reason: The root evidence reports noun-only Quranic behavior, and the local form is a plural abstract noun.

topics.headline: opening formula and surah thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the opening phrase as part of a repeated Book-sign formula and as the start of a local sign discourse.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows tie the phrase to opening formulas at 10:1, 12:1, 15:1, 26:2, 27:1, 28:2, and 31:2, and to same-surah returns at 13:2, 13:7, 13:27, and 13:38.

words.gloss_range: the definite Book as the genitive domain and authority of the signs
words.root_gloss_range: writing, prescribing, recording, decreeing, and joining into a written whole
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكِتَٰبِ}} ({{tr:al-kitābi}}) completes the construct as the definite domain of the signs. The Book is a recognized written authority, carrying record and decree pressure, while the stitching image helps picture many signs joined into one coherent whole without replacing the local Book sense. Its place before the descent clause also puts the Book inside a revelation-axis that returns later in the surah (13:36; 13:38; 13:39; 13:43).

topics.headline: definite genitive Book-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Book is the recognized domain of the signs, not a second predicate beside them.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the Book a definite genitive complement governed by the sign plural.

topics.headline: written and decreed authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears Book-language as written authority and binding decree, not merely as information.
topics.reason: The root family supports writing, prescription, record, and decree, and the local noun is the institutional Book-form.

topics.headline: stitched whole image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can imagine many signs joined into one coherent Book, while the local sense remains Book or scripture.
topics.reason: The sewing or joining image is valid root background but must be kept as an image that colors textual coherence, not as the local lexical sense.

topics.headline: Book within revelation axis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Book is immediately framed by descent and later remains a local written-authority thread.
topics.reason: The rows connect the Book with descent in this ayah and with same-surah returns at 13:36, 13:38, 13:39, and 13:43.

words.gloss_range: connector before the relative revelation clause, allowing coordination or resumption
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is small but structural: it decides whether the following revelation-truth clause is coordinated with the Book-sign declaration or resumed as a fresh assertion. Because it is bound onto the relative pronoun, the transition is still heard as connected, not detached.

topics.headline: coordination or resumption hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the connector controls whether the revelation-truth clause is fused with the prior declaration or resumed as a new assertion.
topics.reason: The grammar allows coordination and resumption, and both keep the following relative clause connected to the Book-sign claim.

topics.headline: bound transition into the relative clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the transition as joined rather than isolated because the connector is bound to the relative pronoun.
topics.reason: The proclitic form and liaison rows make the clause-link visible and audible before a final parse choice is made.

words.gloss_range: masculine singular relative pronoun presenting the revealed content as one entity
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِىٓ}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) turns the revealed matter into one grammatical entity after the plural signs. It does not name the subject directly; it defines it by the descent clause that follows, and local grammar selects revealed content rather than a personal agent.

topics.headline: one revealed entity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from plural signs to one revealed entity.
topics.reason: The masculine singular relative pronoun matches the Book or revealed content as a unified subject rather than a scattered plural.

topics.headline: subject defined by descent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the subject is identified by what happened to it: it was sent down to the addressee from his Lord.
topics.reason: The relative clause supplies the subject identity before the truth predicate arrives.

topics.headline: impersonal revealed content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader avoids taking the relative pronoun as a personal agent; locally it points to revealed content.
topics.reason: The descent verb and truth predicate select thing-content for the relative pronoun, while the personal sense is blocked in this context.

words.gloss_range: completed caused descent in passive form, with recipient and source supplied by prepositional phrases
words.root_gloss_range: descent, sending down, alighting, arrival, and lodging; local Form IV passive selects caused completed revelation
words.prose: {{ar:أُنزِلَ}} ({{tr:unzila}}) presents revelation as a completed caused descent in passive form. The revealed object is foregrounded while the source and recipient are supplied by the surrounding prepositional phrases. The root imagery of alighting and arrival strengthens the reception frame, and later same-surah uses contrast received descent with demands for descent (13:7; 13:17; 13:19; 13:27; 13:36; 13:37).

topics.headline: completed passive caused descent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices revelation as an accomplished caused descent with the revealed object foregrounded and the sender not named inside the verb.
topics.reason: QAC parses Form IV perfect passive; attachment evidence makes the relative pronoun the passive subject while source is supplied separately.

topics.headline: arrival and reception pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the descent as arrival at a recipient, while the local verb remains the revelation descent form.
topics.reason: The n-z-l alighting and lodging imagery supports reception pressure, but local Form IV passive selects sent-down revelation rather than hospitality as the sense.

topics.headline: revelation axis and later demands
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the action that joins Book, Lord, and addressee, and later contrasts fact of descent with demands for descent.
topics.reason: The rows identify the Book-Lord-descent axis and same-surah contrasts such as 13:7, 13:17, 13:19, 13:27, 13:36, and 13:37.

words.gloss_range: to-you endpoint phrase with a second-person singular recipient suffix
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَيْكَ}} ({{tr:ilayka}}) makes the Prophet the endpoint of revelation, not its origin. The attached suffix gives the vector a singular addressed recipient, and the phrase pairs with the following source phrase to map descent from Lord to addressee before the address widens in 13:2.

topics.headline: singular addressed endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that revelation is routed to a singular addressed recipient, not generated by him.
topics.reason: The preposition marks endpoint and the attached second-person masculine singular suffix identifies the recipient.

topics.headline: destination before source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the revelation mapped as a vector, with destination named before source.
topics.reason: The to-you phrase pairs with the from-your-Lord phrase around the passive descent verb.

topics.headline: singular receipt to plural aim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that singular prophetic receipt opens toward the plural certainty aim in 13:2.
topics.reason: The boundary row contrasts the singular endpoint in 13:1 with plural addressee language in 13:2.

words.gloss_range: source preposition marking origin from the Lord and tightening the revelation vector
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) marks origin: the revelation is from the Lord while the passive verb leaves the agent grammatically outside the verb form. Its phrase can also press toward the truth predicate, so source of revelation and source-quality of truth remain closely joined. Together with the preceding destination phrase, it completes the from-to vector.

topics.headline: origin-point source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Lord is marked as origin-point of the descent while the passive verb still leaves the agent grammatically unspoken.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the Lord phrase as source and locally selects origin over partitive or explanatory alternatives.

topics.headline: source and truth attachment pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that from-your-Lord can source the descent and also press close to the truth predicate.
topics.reason: The documented attachment options link origin of revelation with truth-quality without forcing a false exclusive choice.

topics.headline: from-to vector completion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the short source phrase complete the spatial architecture of revelation.
topics.reason: The phrase follows the destination phrase and closes the source-to-destination model before the truth predicate.

words.gloss_range: your Lord as personal, relational source of the sent-down revelation
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, ownership, mastery, sustaining, nurturing, and bringing to completion
words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbika}}) names the source as your Lord, personally tied to the singular recipient. The title carries authority, ownership, sustaining, and nurture, so the source is relational rather than impersonal. The same root then widens from singular address to plural Lord-relation in 13:2.

topics.headline: your Lord as personal source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the source is personally related to the addressed recipient: your Lord, not an abstract origin.
topics.reason: The construct with the second-person suffix makes the title definite and personally addressed, and the same suffix links destination and source relation.

topics.headline: authority with nurture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears authority, ownership, sustaining, and formative care inside the source title.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports lordship and nurturing together, and local sourcehood makes that relation relevant to revelation.

topics.headline: source title widens across boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the root handoff from your Lord to your-plural Lord in 13:2.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows trace same-surah r-b-b recurrence and the suffix shift from singular 13:1 to plural 13:2.

words.gloss_range: the definite truth or established reality as the predicate peak of the revelation clause
words.root_gloss_range: truth, reality, right, due claim, establishment, certainty, and entitlement
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَقُّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqu}}) is the predicate peak: what was sent down is the truth as standing identity, not a dated event. The root range gives truth the force of established reality, right, and due claim, so the later denial of belief is measured against something fixed. The term also launches a local truth thread (13:14; 13:17; 13:19) and points toward the certainty movement of 13:2.

topics.headline: atemporal truth predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that truth is asserted as standing identity, not as a dated event.
topics.reason: The nominative predicate in a verbless clause makes the revealed subject the truth, with appositional force also available.

topics.headline: truth, reality, and due claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears truth as established reality and binding right, so later non-belief is judged against a fixed claim.
topics.reason: The root family supports truth, reality, right, due claim, and establishment in the local predicate.

topics.headline: truth paired with belief response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the truth assertion is structurally paired with the final denial of belief and becomes a local thread.
topics.reason: Rows connect the truth predicate to belief response in this ayah and to same-surah returns at 13:14, 13:17, and 13:19.

topics.headline: truth opens toward demonstration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 13:1 moving from truth assertion toward the evidentiary and certainty movement of 13:2.
topics.reason: Boundary rows connect the truth claim to the cosmic demonstration and certainty aim in 13:2.

words.gloss_range: connector that binds the following concessive turn to the truth assertion
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds the contrast clause to the truth assertion it resists. It is not a decorative and; joined to the adversative particle, it turns the ayah from established reality toward failed human reception.

topics.headline: connector into contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the coming non-belief is tied to the truth claim it resists.
topics.reason: The connector before the adversative particle coordinates or resumes the contrast clause without detaching it from the prior assertion.

topics.headline: bound transition unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah turn from declarative truth to reception failure in one compact transition.
topics.reason: The bound form with the following adversative particle compresses the contrastive movement.

words.gloss_range: heavy adversative particle governing the majority phrase and its negated-belief predicate
words.prose: {{ar:لَٰكِنَّ}} ({{tr:lākinna}}) is the heavy adversative that governs the final clause. It makes the contrast grammatical: after truth has been asserted, the expected belief response is corrected by majority non-belief. The doubled sound matches the weight of that turn.

topics.headline: heavy governed adversative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the contrast is grammatically built as a governed clause, not merely added as a loose objection.
topics.reason: The heavy form belongs to the inna-family, governs the majority phrase, and takes the negated verb clause as predicate.

topics.headline: truth met by failed uptake
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's central irony: truth is established, yet the expected belief response fails.
topics.reason: The particle marks istidrāk after the truth predicate, redirecting from established reality to majority non-belief.

topics.headline: audible weight of contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the doubled consonant as matching the grammatical weight of the adversative turn.
topics.reason: The form and prosody rows connect gemination with the heavy governed particle.

words.gloss_range: construct elative majority, the larger portion of the people under the concessive particle
words.root_gloss_range: abundance, increase, manyness, accumulation, and comparative or superlative majority
words.prose: {{ar:أَكْثَرَ}} ({{tr:akthara}}) is the governed construct head: most of the people, not all people without remainder. Its abundance root makes the irony sharper because numerical weight stands against established truth rather than confirming it. The wording participates in a repeated majority non-belief formula (11:17; 12:103; 13:1; 40:59).

topics.headline: partitive governed majority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause speaks of the greater part of the people, not all people without remainder.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the word the governed noun of the adversative particle and the construct head over the definite people complement.

topics.headline: abundance opposed to truth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees numerical prevalence set against truth, so majority response does not define reality.
topics.reason: The abundance root and elative form make quantity itself the irony in the concessive clause.

topics.headline: repeated majority non-belief formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this as a repeated Quranic diagnosis, not an isolated statistic.
topics.reason: The rows identify the formula with cross-references 11:17, 12:103, 13:1, and 40:59, plus local people-discourse returns at 13:6, 13:17, and 13:31.

words.gloss_range: the definite human collective as the genitive whole from which the majority is carved out
words.root_gloss_range: humanity, perception, sociability, and intimacy; forgetfulness is a disputed contrastive background
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}) supplies the definite human whole from which the majority is selected. The people are not the independent subject as a totality; they are the population over which the majority claim is measured. The perception and sociability background sharpens the irony of a human collective evaluated by failed trust, and the same people-discourse continues locally (13:6; 13:17; 13:31).

topics.headline: people as genitive whole
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that humanity supplies the whole from which the majority is selected, leaving room for a believing minority.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under the construct head, so it is not the independent subject and does not make all people the direct claim.

topics.headline: perceptive-social humanity under denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the irony that perceptive social beings are evaluated by failure to enter trust.
topics.reason: The perception and sociability root evidence is meaningful, while the n-s-y forgetfulness alternative remains contrastive background rather than the local root assignment.

topics.headline: collective human response thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees people, majority, and belief forming a human-response triad that continues within the surah.
topics.reason: Rows connect the people noun with same-surah returns at 13:6, 13:17, and 13:31 and with the repeated majority-belief formula.

words.gloss_range: present or habitual negation scoped over the final imperfect verb
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) negates the following imperfect as an ongoing or habitual state, not as one past refusal. It stays outside the verb and scopes narrowly over the belief predicate. Because it stands immediately before the final word, the ayah can end on belief as a concept while denying it as actual response.

topics.headline: present habitual negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial concerns ongoing or habitual belief, not one completed past refusal.
topics.reason: The negator before an imperfect indicative selects present or habitual negation rather than past-jussive or future-denial frames.

topics.headline: narrow separate negator
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees negation standing outside the intact verb and scoped to the belief predicate.
topics.reason: The particle does not fuse with or alter the verb; it reverses the predicate value while preserving the final verb form.

topics.headline: penultimate negation before final belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah end on belief as a concept while the immediately preceding particle removes it as actual response.
topics.reason: The negator stands after the truth assertion and before the final verb, creating the terminal polarity between established truth and absent trust.

words.gloss_range: objectless Form IV imperfect under negation, presenting ongoing non-belief as the final human response
words.root_gloss_range: safety, security, trust, belief, faith, and giving security; local objectless Form IV selects belief or trust response
words.prose: {{ar:يُؤْمِنُونَ}} ({{tr:yuʾminūna}}) closes the ayah as an objectless imperfect under negation: ongoing non-belief, not refusal of one named object. The security-root background keeps belief as trust-relation, while local syntax keeps the selected sense intransitive and unbounded. The final word completes the repeated majority non-belief formula (12:103; 13:1; 40:59) and hands the diagnosis to the certainty-oriented evidence of 13:2.

topics.headline: ongoing objectless non-belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that non-belief is stated as an ongoing unbounded state, not as refusal of one named object.
topics.reason: The imperfect indicative remains under present negation and the verb closes the ayah without an explicit complement.

topics.headline: belief-trust from security root
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears belief as trust-relation from the security root, while the local objectless frame keeps the selected sense as believing or trusting.
topics.reason: The Form IV member belongs to the safety and trust family; transitive security-giving pressure is background because no object is expressed locally.

topics.headline: formulaic final faith-under-negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah closing on a repeated majority non-belief formula and on belief as the final negated concept.
topics.reason: Rows identify the formula at 12:103, 13:1, and 40:59 and make final position central to the rhetorical closure.

topics.headline: non-belief hands off to certainty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the closing diagnosis prepare the next ayah's evidentiary remedy and certainty aim.
topics.reason: Boundary rows contrast denied belief in 13:1 with the certainty goal and cosmic evidence in 13:2.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 3-4, 6, 10, and 15 link signs, Book, descent, truth, and non-belief.
baseline_models.mechanism: Marked units are joined as writing; their agreement with fixed reality makes a claim true, and belief is assent in which the heart can settle. The Book is an evidentiary composition rather than an opaque title.

activation_trace.role: Visible marking makes each ayah an inspectable indicator.
Joining separate pieces makes the Book a coordinated whole.
Ordered letters give that joined whole its written form.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the criterion of truth.
Heart-resting assent names the intended reception of the evidence.

changed_reading.before: These are verses of the Book, and the delivered message is true.
changed_reading.after: These marked units form a mutually supporting written whole whose correspondence with reality solicits settled assent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence Book, sent down from your Lord, truth, and non-belief at words 4-15.
baseline_models.mechanism: A sovereign source delivers an established determination; truth is not only accuracy but a due that has become binding, while belief supplies the corresponding relation of trust and entrusted response.

activation_trace.role: A written determination supplies the binding register or judgment.
Caused delivery makes the determination arrive from its source to its addressee.
Ownership and governing authority ground the determination's claim.
A fixed due turns truth from description into an obligation with standing.
Security, trust, and entrusted fidelity supply the fitting human response.

changed_reading.before: The revelation accurately states facts even though most reject it.
changed_reading.after: The delivered truth also bears a binding claim from its governing source, so non-belief is a failure of entrusted response as well as assent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive descent from the Lord at words 6-9 and the predication of truth at word 10.
baseline_models.mechanism: Descent can be placement at an apt station, while both mapped branches of the source root contribute completion and growth. Truth then appears as a communication fitted and reinforced for developmental reception, not merely transported downward.

activation_trace.role: Putting something in its proper rank turns descent into calibrated placement.
Repair, nurture, and completion give the source relation a staged pedagogical function.
The alternate mapped growth branch keeps developmental nourishment live rather than collapsing the split root.
Tight, corrected construction makes truth the robustness of the placed communication.
A part fitting its proper joint supplies the image of exact contextual fit.

changed_reading.before: A true message moved vertically from the Lord to the recipient.
changed_reading.after: A nurturing source placed a robust communication at the fitting human level so that reception could mature.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Visible signs at word 3 stand against most people not believing at words 12-15.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse juxtaposes marked visibility with a human collective whose root inventory includes perceiving and becoming familiar, yet numerical predominance does not become inward security. The failure is paradoxically perceptual, social, and fiduciary at once.

activation_trace.role: An outward mark supplies evidence available to perception.
Predominance by number makes the majority socially weighty without making it evidentially right.
Visible humanity supplies the collective that stands before the visible marks.
Seeing, hearing, and sensing sharpen the irony of evidence that is encountered but not received.
Inward security and trust mark what perception and social familiarity fail to produce.

changed_reading.before: A large demographic group does not accept the message.
changed_reading.after: The perceptive human majority can stand among visible indicators yet remain inwardly unentrusted and unsettled by them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah turns the opening sign-system outward: elevated structures and timed motions are governed with their outcomes in view, then articulated as distinct signs whose intended endpoint is certainty.

activation_trace.role: Physical elevation supplies the large-scale structure that becomes readable evidence.
Planning by consequences makes the displayed system governed rather than accidental.
Articulating parts and meanings turns the signs into an explanatory sequence.
Knowledge fixed after doubt supplies the reception toward which exposition is directed.

structural_cues: 13:2 moves from raised heavens without visible supports through regulated trajectories and deadlines to detailed signs, encounter with the Lord, and certainty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies elevation, governed trajectories, articulated signs, and certainty; I infer that the opening Book trains perception of a managed world. A live alternative is that creation is separate corroboration rather than an extension of the Book's sign-system.

changed_reading.before: The Book contains verbal indicators that state a true message.
changed_reading.after: The Book's indicators disclose the same ordered governance visible in the world and train the reader from observed structure toward certainty.

context_deltas.mechanism: Separated but neighboring plots share one input and yield unequal outcomes. This makes an ayah function as a controlled comparison: hold source and proximity steady, inspect difference, then bind the observations into reasoned judgment.

activation_trace.role: Distinct pieces establish comparable units without erasing their separation.
Physical adjacency controls distance while preserving difference between the units.
Union in one respect supplies the common input against which outcomes can be compared.
Surplus and differential outcome make variation itself evidentiary.
A reason that restrains error binds the separated observations into a warranted inference.

structural_cues: 13:3-4 repeat signs after paired forms, adjacent plots, one water, unequal produce, and a closing appeal to reasoning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pieces, adjacency, common input, unequal yield, and reason; I supply the controlled-comparison arrow. The alternative is a catalog of wonders with no experimental relation among them.

changed_reading.before: The signs are individual wonders collected in a Book.
changed_reading.after: The signs also teach a comparative method in which controlled sameness and neighboring difference jointly reveal ordered causation.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the opening presents plural signs joined in a Book, denial of renewed creation is followed by a demand that one sign be sent down. Disbelief can therefore work by covering an available system while continually narrowing admissible evidence to a newly demanded token.

activation_trace.role: Reaction to the unfamiliar exposes surprise as the pressure point in the denial of renewed creation.
Covering the truth makes rejection an active screening operation rather than simple absence of data.
Demanded delivery repeats the opening's descent relation but turns it into a condition imposed by the hearer.
A visible mark is requested in the singular despite the already asserted plurality of indicators.
Warning aims to awaken caution rather than satisfy an escalating spectacle test.
Gentle direction supplies a non-coercive mode of guidance for each community.

structural_cues: 13:5 labels the resurrection claim surprising; 13:7 repeats descent-sign-Lord as a demand for one sign after 13:1 has already asserted signs and Book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, repeated opening vocabulary, and a singular demand; I infer a moving admission threshold. The demand could instead be sincere but aimed at a different class of sign.

changed_reading.before: Most people fail to believe because the revelation does not persuade them.
changed_reading.after: Non-belief may manufacture evidentiary scarcity by covering an integrated sign-system and demanding an isolated token on its own terms.

context_deltas.mechanism: The true call is set against invocations that receive no answer and against hands extended toward water that never reaches the mouth. Truth acquires a relational test: a sound address connects source, recipient, answer, and attainable end.

activation_trace.role: Calling by speech supplies the initiating address whose effectiveness is being contrasted.
Stable truth qualifies the call that genuinely corresponds to its addressee and end.
A returned answer supplies the missing link in the futile invocations.
Extending the hand provides effort and direction without guaranteeing contact.
An outstretched asking hand makes failed reception bodily visible.
Arrival at the intended endpoint supplies the criterion the water image fails.
Missing the intended path names the failed address-response circuit.

structural_cues: 13:14 contrasts a true call with non-response, then repeats reaching in a hand-water-mouth image whose goal is explicitly not attained.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call, answer, extension, and failed arrival; I infer that efficacy belongs to the focus truth's communicative force. The alternative is that the image evaluates worship alone without revising the opening's truth predicate.

changed_reading.before: Truth is a property predicated of the content sent down.
changed_reading.after: Truth also names a viable address-response relation in which the delivered word can reach, orient, and be answered, unlike a call with no attainable respondent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Descent initiates capacity-bounded flows that carry swelling surface froth; the froth departs while useful matter remains. The opening's truth is no longer only a proposition at arrival: it is what survives reception, turbulence, and separation as durable benefit.

activation_trace.role: Delivery from above supplies the initiating input and directly recalls the focus descent.
A measure that bounds each thing makes channel capacity control the resulting flow.
Visible carrying moves the byproduct with the flood rather than making it the flood's substance.
Floating froth supplies a prominent but superficial surplus produced by agitation.
Swelling height explains how false surplus can look dominant at the surface.
Fixed correspondence identifies the stable side of the explicit contrast.
Loss of truth and stability names what cannot survive the separating process.
Concrete benefit supplies a functional test beyond visual prominence.
Remaining with duration makes persistence the temporal test of the useful remainder.

structural_cues: 13:17 orders descent, channels by capacity, carried froth, a truth-falsehood comparison, disappearance of froth, and the remaining benefit to people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the full material sequence and explicitly names truth and falsehood; I infer that it reprocesses the opening's descended truth through reception over time. The live alternative is a general parable whose truth need not be identified specifically with the Book.

changed_reading.before: What arrives from the Lord is propositionally true at the moment of delivery.
changed_reading.after: Descended truth proves itself through capacity-sensitive reception: noisy surplus separates away, while a stable and beneficial remainder endures.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus descent-Lord-truth proposition is repeated almost verbatim, then its receiver is contrasted with inner blindness and characterized by recollection. Belief becomes recovered perception and knowledge, not bare subscription to a sentence.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower turns reception of the proposition into cognition.
Repeated delivery pins the cognitive contrast directly to the focus revelation.
Nurturing completion keeps knowledge relational to the source rather than merely informational.
Reality-correspondence is the object disclosed to the knower.
Blindness of inward perception supplies the contrary mode of reception.
Recovering what was held but not present makes understanding an act of recollection.

structural_cues: 13:19 repeats the opening clause, contrasts knower with blind, and ends with branchless ل ب ب at word 15; that uncitable root is used only as the structural cue of an inner core.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact verbal recurrence, knowledge, blindness, recollection, and an inner-core cue; I infer a reception model of recognition. The alternative is that these are consequences of prior belief rather than an unpacking of it.

changed_reading.before: Belief means accepting the true status of what was sent down.
changed_reading.after: Belief involves recognizing the descended truth with inward sight and recollective understanding; denial is a mode of blindness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those who know the truth complete a preserved compact, refuse to unbind it, and connect what is ordered; the opposite group unbinds, cuts connection, and drives things out of sound order. The Book's binding judgment becomes a maintained relational network.

activation_trace.role: Completion without deficiency supplies faithful performance of the compact.
A preserved compact trusted by its holder gives the obligation relational form.
Unbinding what was made firm defines the prohibited reversal.
A confirmed covenant supplies the firmness that unbinding would destroy.
Unbroken succession makes fidelity an ongoing connection rather than a momentary assent.
Severing a bond supplies the social and structural opposite of faithful reception.
Departure from sound order names the system-level result of broken connection.

structural_cues: 13:20-25 mirror completing, preserving, and connecting against unbinding, cutting, and corrupting, with opposed outcomes.
The branchless root د ر ء at 13:22 word 13 marks reversal of harm with good and is used only as a structural cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the mirrored connection vocabulary and enacted practices; I infer that these operationalize the focus branches of binding Book, due truth, and entrusted belief. They may instead be downstream ethics rather than semantic expansion.

changed_reading.before: The Book imposes a true claim that a believer accepts.
changed_reading.after: Accepting the Book means maintaining a covenantal network through completion and connection; disbelief materializes as unbinding, severance, and systemic disorder.

context_deltas.mechanism: The security branch latent in belief becomes explicit as repeated settling of hearts through repeated remembrance, then belief is coupled with intentional work and repair. Trust is a stabilized inner process with outward consequences.

activation_trace.role: Security and trust provide the latent state that the following heart sequence makes explicit.
Repeated stilling and reassurance realize belief as an achieved inner stability.
The heart supplies the locus in which trust becomes settled rather than merely spoken.
Repeated recollection supplies the process that restores and maintains stability.
Intentional action carries settled trust into purposeful conduct.
Soundness opposed to corruption gives that conduct its reparative direction.

structural_cues: 13:28 repeats heart-settling-remembrance in a reversed formulation, and 13:29 immediately couples belief with work that is sound.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies belief, doubled tranquility, doubled heart and remembrance, then work and repair; I infer a maintenance loop from remembrance to settled trust to action. Tranquility may instead be only a consequence of belief.

changed_reading.before: To believe is to assent to the truth of the delivered content.
changed_reading.after: To believe is also to enter a recurrent process in which remembrance settles the heart into trust and trust issues in reparative action.

context_deltas.mechanism: A recited, collected discourse is placed in a counterfactual series of moving mountains, cutting earth, and making the dead speak, yet universal human guidance remains assigned to divine willing. The Book guides without functioning as a machine that compels belief by spectacle.

activation_trace.role: Recitation names the discourse whose imagined physical effects are being tested.
Caused movement supplies the first spectacular transformation.
A high solid mass makes that movement maximally resistant and visible.
Physical severing supplies the second coercively visible transformation.
Meaningful speech connecting speakers supplies the third impossible communication.
Loss of life makes speech the strongest boundary-crossing sign in the series.
Assent remains present after the spectacle series rather than being mechanically produced by it.
Gentle direction offers a mode of guidance distinct from physical compulsion.
The whole visible human collective is the stated horizon of the unrealized universal guidance.

structural_cues: 13:31 orders three counterfactual transformations, returns all command to God, then places belief, willing, guidance, and all people in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the counterfactual spectacle and the unforced guidance clause; I infer a distinction between revelatory address and mechanical compulsion. A live alternative is that the counterfactual magnifies this discourse's power rather than limiting spectacle as a mode of proof.

changed_reading.before: The signs fail to make most people believe despite their evidentiary force.
changed_reading.after: The Book's mode is communicative guidance, not a physical mechanism that overrides the recipient and converts the whole human collective by spectacle.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Book moves through written reception, partial denial, articulated judgment, a register for each term, erasure and confirmation, and a source register. The opening definite Book can therefore activate as layered administration: communicative inscription, binding allocation, and authoritative source need not be the same level.

activation_trace.role: Written form supplies the received textual layer over which audiences divide.
Failure to recognize or acknowledge supplies one reception mode.
Partition makes denial selective rather than an all-or-nothing response.
Judgment gives the descended discourse an executable normative layer.
Clear articulation makes that judgment linguistically addressable rather than abstract.
A delimited term supplies the temporal key by which a register is allocated.
A fixed determination makes each temporal register operative rather than merely documentary.
Removal of an inscription's trace supplies controlled mutability within the register system.
Proof and confirmation supply the complementary act that authorizes what remains.
An origin, collector, and reference point supplies a source layer for derivative registers.
The source Book holds authoritative determination even while lower traces can be erased or confirmed.

structural_cues: 13:36-39 sequence received Book, selective denial, descended articulated judgment, a Book for every term, erasure, confirmation, and the mother or source of the Book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence and all register operations; I supply a layered relation between the opening definite Book, term-specific books, and source Book. The alternative is that these uses remain distinct without revising the opening referent.

changed_reading.before: The Book is a stable codex containing the true revelation.
changed_reading.after: The Book is also a layered temporal register: articulated text and binding allocations can be administered through erasure and confirmation under an authoritative source register.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing denial of messengership is answered by sufficient witness and by one who has knowledge of the Book. The opening Book is thus not self-enclosed text: its truth enters an evidentiary relation of knowing testimony.

activation_trace.role: Standing for the matter until it suffices supplies the adequacy of the answer to denial.
Testimony grounded in knowledge makes truth publicly evidentiary.
A sign that bears witness links the closing testimony back to the opening indicators.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the human side of the witness relation.
The written Book supplies the knowable object through which testimony is qualified.

structural_cues: 13:43 begins with denial of the messenger and closes the surah with sufficiency, witness, relational betweenness, knowledge, and Book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial and two forms of knowledgeable witness; I infer that the Book participates in a testimonial ecology. The alternative is that only its knower testifies, so the Book itself should not be personified as a witness.

changed_reading.before: The Book asserts its own truth despite majority rejection.
changed_reading.after: The Book's truth is knowable and witness-bearing within relations of testimony that answer rejection without making the text a self-sufficient object.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The social majority is never explicitly equated with foam, so the cross-domain mapping is surprising; it remains anchored in the focus words for most, people, truth, and belief and in 13:17's rising froth versus enduring human benefit. Render only as an analogy that strips number of truth-weight, not as an identification of people with waste.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The majority claim at words 12-15 beside truth at word 10.

activation_trace.role: Numerical abundance supplies the focus quantity whose epistemic weight is being questioned.
Winning by numbers supplies the social pressure that can masquerade as evidentiary force.
Floating froth gives abundance a visually dominant but superficial material analogue.
Swelling upward explains how surface quantity can temporarily command attention.
Benefit supplies a criterion independent of bulk.
Persistence supplies a criterion independent of temporary predominance.

changed_reading.before: Most people names only the scale of non-belief.
changed_reading.after: The later foam process makes numerical predominance itself suspect: a swelling majority can dominate the surface without carrying the durable weight of truth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Reading the signs through the remote waiting branch is form-distant from the ordinary noun and therefore surprising; it remains anchored by the supplied focus branch, descent's station branch, and later duration cues. Render as a temporal reading practice invited by the root inventory, never as the lexical definition of ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Signs at word 3 and descent at word 6.

activation_trace.role: Lingering and waiting turn a sign from an instant token into a place of sustained attention.
A station or lodging gives descent a place where the reader can remain.
A fixed temporal limit places the displayed motions inside duration.
Remaining with patience makes truth's persistence visible only after turbulence passes.
Each delimited term reinforces signs and registers as temporally staged rather than instantaneous.

changed_reading.before: A sign should deliver immediate proof on inspection.
changed_reading.after: A sign can be a station at which perception must linger until transient surplus passes and the truth's durable remainder appears.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The packet never calls shadows written characters, so treating them as script is a deliberately cross-domain activation; it remains anchored in visible signs, written Book, bodily bending, cast shadows, and the two edges of day. Render only as a metaphor for involuntary embodied testimony alongside conscious non-belief.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Visible signs and written Book at words 3-4 against human non-belief at words 12-15.

activation_trace.role: Visible marking permits natural forms to be read as indicators.
Inscribed ordering supplies the metaphorical script into which moving marks are composed.
Bending down gives the script a bodily grammar of submission.
A shadow cast by an upright body supplies the moving visible stroke.
The beginning of day sets one temporal edge of the moving inscription.
Late day sets the other temporal edge across which the shadow changes.

changed_reading.before: The Book's signs are textual claims that many humans consciously reject.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory level, daily shadows form a moving script of embodied submission even where conscious human trust remains absent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The semiotic contrast between the opening signs and the command to name partners is inferred rather than stated, which makes it surprising; it remains anchored in signs, truth, naming, reporting, knowledge, outward speech, and adornment. Render as a contrast between grounded and ungrounded signs, not as a claim that every false name is grammatically equivalent to disbelief.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Marked signs at word 3 and reality-corresponding truth at word 10.

activation_trace.role: A visible indicator supplies the focus model of a sign grounded in what it marks.
Correspondence with stable reality supplies the test for grounded signification.
Naming as designation supplies labels whose referents are being challenged.
A reported item should bring information rather than merely circulate a label.
Disclosure to knowledge supplies the missing warrant for the named partners.
Outward appearance supplies the merely surface level at which unsupported speech can operate.
A thing's own indication contrasts meaningful signification with imposed verbal naming.
Applied beautification explains how an unsupported construction can become persuasive in appearance.

changed_reading.before: The opening signs state truth while disbelievers reject it.
changed_reading.after: The opening signs can also be read as grounded names whose referents withstand knowledge, unlike adorned surface speech that assigns names without disclosed reality.

strongest_changes: The opening signs became an ordered comparative apparatus that reads differentiated systems rather than a list of wonders.
Truth became the durable, beneficial remainder that survives capacity-bound flow and material separation.
Belief became settled entrusted response, then covenantal connection and reparative action, rather than bare assent.
The Book became simultaneously composed writing, binding judgment, timed register, and witnessed knowledge.
summary.what_was_special: Repeated opening vocabulary did opposite work: 13:7 exposed a demand that screens out an already-given sign-system, while 13:19 turned the same descent-Lord-truth proposition into knowledge versus blindness. The material foam process and the erase-confirm register preserved distinct readings that a single doctrinal paraphrase would collapse. Branchless ل ب ب and د ر ء were used only as structural cues.
remaining_uncertainties: The transfer from 13:17's general truth-falsehood parable specifically back to the descended Book is abductive, though repeated descent and truth roots make it strong.
The register model depends on relating the definite Book of 13:1 to term-specific books and the source Book of 13:38-39; the uses may remain distinct layers without revising one referent.
The waiting-sign, numerical-foam, shadow-script, and name-referent readings are exploratory analogies and should not be rendered as lexical definitions.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. `ك ت ب/B001` is joining one thing to another, while `ك ت ب/B002` is joined letters as writing. Covenant is later kept or undone (13:20, 25), and the close invokes knowledge of the book (13:43). I infer that the signs are mutually fastening members, so the book reads as a relational construction rather than loose units.
2. `ح ق ق/B001` is firm truth against falsehood. Ayah 13:17 materially separates durable benefit from departing froth; I infer that persistence under testing evidences truth. `ٱلْحَقُّ` thus becomes what survives flow, fire, and reckoning, while insecure assent (`ء م ن/B001–B002`) fails to hold it.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 13:43 turned the joined book into an evidentiary whole, while 13:17 supplied the unexpected material test for `ٱلْحَقُّ`.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A joined text whose truth acquires binding force.** `ك ت ب / B001` is joining one thing to another, `ك ت ب / B002` joins letters into writing, and `ح ق ق / B010` is tight-made firmness. The demonstrative `تِلْكَ` points to textual signs, after which 13:2-4 set cosmic, terrestrial, and agricultural signs in an ordered sequence; 13:5-6 then attach denial to consequence. I assign joining the role of integrating those heterogeneous signs and firmness the role of making their relation hold. The packet supplies the joined book, ordered signs, and consequences; I infer coherent joining -> evidential firmness. What was “sent down” reads as a binding architecture of relations, not an isolated assertion that merely demands assent.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 13:2's `يُفَصِّلُ ٱلْءَايَاتِ` corrected an initially static “book” reading: joining and detailing are complementary, since the joined whole becomes firm by exposing its parts. The ordered signs in 13:3-4 then supplied the joined content.

baseline.text: Elif Lâm Mîm Râ. Bunlar Kitabın ayetleridir. Rabbinden sana indirilen gerçektir; fakat insanların çoğu inanmaz.

findings.text: Kitap, dağınık cümlelerin toplamı değil, ayetlerin birbirini tutarak kanıt değeri kazandığı bağlı bir bütündür.
Gerçeklik, sınama sırasında dağılan görünüşten ayrılıp yararlı biçimde kalabilme sağlamlığıyla belirginleşir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Authority establishes order, delegates care, and draws subjects into willing or compelled alignment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Kingship, custodial care, and bodily submission are distinct scenes joined by ordered dependence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Throne, Dominion, and Administration
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A sovereign occupies the raised seat, owns the domain, and manages affairs toward their outcomes.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: lordship, mastery, and sovereignty (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); raised royal throne (`quranic:root_001000:B001/m01`); dominion and governing power (`quranic:root_001444:B003/m01`); office and holder of authority (`quranic:root_000051:B003/m01`); administration by looking to consequences (`quranic:root_000458:B006/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:1-2 `رَبّ` (ر ب ب); 13:2 `العَرْش` (ع ر ش), `الأَمْر` (ء م ر), and `يُدَبِّرُ` (د ب ر); 13:13, 13:16 `مَلَائِكَة`/`يَمْلِكُون` (م ل ك).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Throne, dominion, office, and consequence-aware administration produce a specific court of rule. The surface ordering of creation is thereby reframed as active governance.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi oyalanma, durup bekleme, bir isin imkanini bekleme ve kalinan yer anlamlarini birlikte verir. Verilen dal cercevesi bu bekleme ve kalma cekirdegini sadik bicimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal hedefe yonelme, isaret adi veya soru edati degil; bekleme ve kalma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bare kapsam, anlami kokten gelen bekleme ve kalma cekirdegiyle sinirlar; baska edat veya ad kullanimlari buraya alinmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerde veya bir isin basinda oyalanarak durmak, beklemek ya da kalinacak yer olarak tutulmak.

facets.statement: Kisi veya sey hareketi erteleyip durur, oyalanir ya da bekler.
Bir isin gerceklesme imkanini bekleme anlami da ayni durup bekleme cekirdegine baglidir.
Kalinan veya beklenilen yer icin konaklama ve tutulma yeri anlaminda adlasmis kullanim vardir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalin temelini durma, oyalanma ve bekleme olarak verir; ayrica bir isin imkanini bekleme ve kalinacak yer kullanimi ayni anlam alaninda yer alir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Durma, oyalanma, bekleme ve kalinan yer baglantisini en kisa bicimde tasir.

error_profile.preserves: Bekleme ve oyalanarak durma cekirdegini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kalinan yer olarak adlasmis kullanim tam olarak gorunmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Fiil olarak kisinin hareket etmeyip bekledigi baglamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Durma ve bekleme eylemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir isin olabilirligini bekleme baglaminda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Isin imkanini bekleme yonunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yer adi olarak konaklama veya tutulma yeri anlaminda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Mekan ve kalma sonucunu korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka bir şeye katıp aralarında fiziksel ya da topluluk oluşturan bir bağ kurmaktır. Derileri dikme, açıklıkları bağlama veya kapatma ve insan ya da atları düzenli bir birlik hâline getirme bunun yapıya bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir şeyi başka bir şeye katarak ikisini bir bütün veya bağlı bir düzen içinde birleştirmektir.
Deri parçalarını ya da bir su tulumunu dikişle birleştirmek, çekirdeğin el işi alanındaki özel gerçekleşmesidir.
Bir hayvanın belirli uzuvlarını halka, kayış veya iple birbirine bağlamak ve bir kabın ağzını sıkıca kapatmak yapıya bağlı kullanımlardır.
Atların veya askerlerin toplanıp ayrı ve düzenli bir birlik oluşturması, fiziksel birleştirmeden topluluk düzenine uzanan anlamdır.
Kayışın iki yüzünü bir arada tutan boncuk, ortaya çıkan bağın somut bir örneğidir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل صحيح واحد يدل على جمع شيء إلى شيء (maqayis)؛ أصل الكتب ضمك الشيء إلى الشيء (jamhara)؛ ضم أديم إلى أديم بالخياطة (mufradat)؛ كتبت السقاء إذا خرزته (tahdhib)؛ كتبت البغلة إذا جمعت بين شفريها بحلقة (sihah;mufradat)؛ الكتيبة جماعة مستحيزة (sihah;tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi harfleri çizgiyle düzenleyerek yazma işlemini, bunun ürünü olan yazılı metin veya sayfayı ve yazdırma, isteme ya da öğretme gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımları birlikte tanıklar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yazı üretimi ve yazılı ürünle sınırlıdır; yazının bağlayıcı hüküm için mecazlaşması ayrı dalda tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yazma işlemi ve yazılı ürün dalın merkezindedir; dikte ettirme, başkasından yazmasını isteme ve yazmayı öğretme anlamları yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Harfleri çizgiyle düzenleyerek yazılı bir metin oluşturmak ve bu işlemin ürünü olan metin ya da yazılı sayfadır. Birine yazdırma, ondan yazmasını isteme ve yazmayı öğretme ise belirli yapılara bağlı uzantılardır.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, harfleri yazıyla düzenleyip bir metin oluşturmak veya var olan metni kopyalamaktır.
İşlemin ürünü, yazılmış metin veya üzerinde bu metnin bulunduğu sayfa ya da kitaptır.
Bir metni başkasına söyleyerek yazdırmak ve birinden kendisi için yazmasını istemek yapıya bağlı ettirgen ve isteme kullanımlarıdır.
Yazmayı öğretmek, yazı öğretmeni ve öğretim yeri anlamları yazı edinimi alanındaki bağlı kullanımlardır.
Öğretim yerindeki çocuklar veya onların topluluğu için kullanılan biçim, yeri değil öğrencileri gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yazmayı harfleri çizgiyle bir araya getiren işlem olarak sunar; yazılı ürün, kopyalama, dikte ettirme, yazma isteği ve öğretimle ilgili kullanımlar bu merkeze bağlanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem harflerden metin oluşturma işlemini hem de ortaya çıkan yazılı ürünü birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Yazı oluşturma işlemi ile yazılı ürün arasındaki temel anlam bağını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir metnin harflerle oluşturulduğu veya mevcut bir metnin yeniden yazıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yazılı metni üretme veya yeniden oluşturma işlemini eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Metnin başkasına söylenerek yazıya geçirilmesinin sağlandığı yapıya bağlı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yazı eyleminin başka bir kişiye yaptırılması anlamını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yazılı metin veya üzerinde yazı bulunan sayfa
birinden kendisi için bir şey yazmasını istemek
yazı öğretmeni veya yazı öğretilen yer
öğretim yerindeki çocuklar veya onların topluluğu

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, sözün taşa kazınması ve yazıya ek olarak oyma işlemini açıkça kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Yazma çekirdeğinde güçlü biçimde örtüşürler; odak dal öğretim ve yazdırma yapılarına uzanırken komşu dal kazıma ve taş üzerine işleme alanına uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal yazı taşıyan sayfa veya yazılı ürün alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal nesne türünü tanımlar; odak dal ise nesnenin yanı sıra yazı oluşturma işlemini de kurucu anlam olarak içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalın çekirdeği yazıyı fiilen oluşturma ve ortaya çıkan yazılı üründür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalın çekirdeği, yazılacak sözleri yazara söyleme işlemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal, bir metnin sözlü aktarım yoluyla yazıya geçirilmesi sürecinde kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Söyleme işlemi komşu dalın merkezidir; odak dalda ise yalnızca yazdırmayı sağlayan yapıya bağlı bir kullanım olup yazma eyleminin yerini almaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday komşular değerlendirildi; seçilen üçü yazı, yazılı nesne ve söyleyerek yazdırma sınırlarını doğrudan aydınlatır, kalanlar ise daha dar nesne türleri veya uzak dal içi ilişkiler sunar.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه كتب الكتاب وكتابته ونسخه، والكتاب اسما للمكتوب أو الصحيفة ذات الكتابة، والتعليم والإملاء والاستكتاب المتعلق بالكتابة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس المراد هنا الفرض والحكم والقدر إلا إذا صارت الكتابة كناية عن الإيجاب أو الإثبات، ولا يدخل فيه سهم الصبيان الصغير.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكتاب والكتابة يقال كتبت الكتاب أكتبه كتبا (maqayis)؛ وقد كتب الكتاب يكتبه كتبا إذا جمع حروفه (jamhara)؛ الكتاب معروف وقد كتبت كتبا وكتابا وكتابة (sihah)؛ كتبت الكتاب كتبا وكتابا فالكتاب اسم لما كتب مجموعا (tahdhib)؛ في التعارف ضم الحروف بعضها إلى بعض بالخط (mufradat)؛ أكتبني هذه القصيدة أي أملها علي (sihah)؛ استكتبه الشيء أي سأله أن يكتبه له (sihah;tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi yükümlülük, hüküm, paylaştırılmış yazgı veya kesinleşmiş karar olarak belirleme alanını açıkça toplar; burada yazı, harf çizme eylemi değil bağlayıcı biçimde belirlemenin anlatım yoludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Salt yazı yazmak bu dala girmez; belirleme işleminin yükümlülük, hüküm veya yazgı sonucu doğurması gerekir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yükümlülük, hüküm ve yazgı değerleri birlikte korunur; birine zorunluluk yükleme ve Tanrı'nın belirlemesi anlamları yalnızca tanıklanmış yapılara bağlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bağlayıcı bir yükümlülük, hüküm veya gerçekleşmesi belirlenmiş pay ve yazgı olarak karara bağlamaktır. Yazma çağrışımı burada harf çizmekten çok kararın kesinleştirilip geçerli kılınmasını anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir işi yapılması gereken bağlayıcı bir yükümlülük olarak belirlemek temel değerlerden biridir.
Bir konuda geçerli ve kesinleşmiş hüküm vermek aynı belirleme çekirdeğinin yargısal yönüdür.
Bir olayın payını, ölçüsünü veya gelecekte gerçekleşecek sonucunu önceden belirlemek yazgı yönünü oluşturur.
Yazma anlatımı, belirlenen hükmün saptanmış, yürürlüğe konmuş ve kesinleşmiş olmasını ifade eder.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yükümlülük, hüküm, yazgı, belirleme ve kesinleşmiş karar değerlerini aynı bağlayıcı saptama alanında birleştirir; yazma sözü bu saptamanın anlatım aracıdır.

concept_gloss.text: bağlayıcı olarak hükme bağlama ve belirleme
concept_gloss.applicability: Yükümlülük, hüküm ve yazgı yönlerini tek bir kesin ve geçerli belirleme çekirdeğinde toplar.

error_profile.preserves: Bağlayıcılık, karar verme ve önceden belirleme yönlerinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir olayın gerçekleşmesini veya kişiye düşecek payı önceden belirleme bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gelecekteki olay veya payın önceden karara bağlanması anlamını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: Tanrı belirledi, karara bağladı veya zorunlu kıldı

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, yükümlülüğe ek olarak hüküm ve önceden belirlenmiş yazgı anlamlarını taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, özellikle yerine getirilmesi gereken ödev ve vazgeçilmez hak türlerini öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal yapılması gereken işi bağlayıcı bir yükümlülük olarak gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Yükümlülük bağlamında yaklaşırlar; ancak odak dalın hüküm ve yazgı kapsamı komşuda yoktur, komşunun ödev ve hak odağı da daha dardır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, hükmün yanında yükümlülük koyma ve olayları önceden belirleme yönlerini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, taraflar arasında karar verme ve uyuşmazlığı kesin biçimde sonuçlandırma işlemini kapsar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكتاب بمعنى الفرض والحكم والقدر، والكتابة بمعنى الإثبات والتقدير والإيجاب والعزم والقضاء الممضى.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الكتاب وهو الفرض (maqayis)؛ يقال للحكم الكتاب (maqayis)؛ يقال للقدر الكتاب (maqayis)؛ الكتاب الفرض والحكم والقدر (sihah)؛ الكتاب يوضع موضع الفرض (tahdhib)؛ يعبر عن الإثبات والتقدير والإيجاب والفرض والعزم بالكتابة (mufradat)؛ يعبر بالكتابة عن القضاء الممضى (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişinin adını pay veya geçim kaydına ya da yönetim siciline geçirmek ile kişiyi tanıklar topluluğuna dâhil etmek arasında ortak bir kayıt ve üyelik çekirdeği kurar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, genel yazma eylemini değil, adı kayda geçirerek kişiyi bir listeye veya belirli topluluğa dâhil etmeyi anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Sicile alma ve topluluğa katma çekirdeği korunur; pay kaydı, yönetim sicili ve tanıklar arasına katılma anlamları kendi tanıklanmış yapılarıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin adını resmî bir pay, geçim veya yönetim kaydına geçirerek onu kayıtlılar arasına almak ya da kişiyi belirli bir topluluğun üyesi saymaktır.

facets.statement: Kişinin adını bir kayıt veya listeye geçirerek ona kayıtlı kişi konumu vermek dalın çekirdeğidir.
Adı pay, geçim tahsisatı veya yönetim siciline yazdırmak resmî kayıt alanındaki özel gerçekleşmedir.
Bir kişiyi tanıklar gibi belirli bir topluluğun içinde saymak, sicile almadan üyelik vermeye uzanan kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak içeriği, adı kayda geçirmenin kişiyi pay alanlar, yönetim sicilindekiler veya belirli bir topluluğun üyeleri arasına sokmasıdır.

concept_gloss.text: adını sicile yazma veya bir gruba dâhil etme
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem resmî sicile alma hem de kişiyi belirli bir topluluğun üyesi sayma anlamlarını kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Adı sicile yazma veya kişiye belirli bir topluluk içinde üyelik verme işlemlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin pay, geçim tahsisatı veya yönetim kaydına kendi adını geçirdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin adını resmî kayda geçirerek kayıtlı konum kazanması anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin tanıklar gibi adı belirli bir topluluğun üyesi sayıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiye belirli topluluk içinde üyelik ve yer verilmesi anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, ad kaydı olmadan nesneleri fiziksel olarak veya insanları düzenli topluluk olarak birleştirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal, ayrı bir kişiyi veya unsuru daha büyük bir bütünün içine katma düşüncesinde buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırıcı özelliği adın kayda geçirilmesi veya üyelik verilmesidir; komşu dalda kayıt koşulu bulunmaz ve birleştirme kendi başına çekirdektir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, kişiyi adını kaydederek bir sicile veya topluluğa dâhil etme işlemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, bir şeyin belirli kişi veya topluluğa özel olmasını ve başkalarından ayrılmasını anlatır.

branches.branch_image_ar: إدخال الاسم في سجل أو زمرة
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الاكتتاب في الفرض والرزق، وكتابة الاسم في ديوان السلطان، ومعنى اجعلنا في زمرة الشاهدين.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو مجرد تأليف كتاب، ولا حكم الفرض نفسه، بل إدخال اسم أو شخص في سجل أو جماعة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكتبة الاكتتاب في الفرض والرزق (ayn;tahdhib)؛ اكتتب فلان أي كتب اسمه في الفرض (ayn;tahdhib)؛ اكتتب الرجل إذا كتب نفسه في ديوان السلطان (sihah)؛ فاكتبنا مع الشاهدين أي اجعلنا في زمرتهم (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, köleleştirilmiş kişinin kendi özgürlük bedelini kazancından ve belirlenmiş ödemelerle karşılaması için sahibiyle yaptığı özel sözleşmeyi, taraflarını ve özgürleşme sonucunu açıkça tanımlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, her türlü yazılı sözleşmeyi değil, bedelin ödenmesiyle özgürlüğe götüren bu özel sözleşme türünü kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım özel sözleşme türüne bağlı kalır; sözleşmenin adı, tarafı ve sözleşme yapma eylemi ayrı tanıklanmış biçimler olarak korunur ve genel sözleşme anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Köleleştirilmiş kişinin, belirlenen bedeli kazancından ve kararlaştırılmış ödemelerle sahibine vererek özgürlüğünü kazanması için taraflar arasında yapılan özel sözleşmedir. Bedel tamamlandığında kişi özgür olur.

facets.statement: Sahip ile köleleştirilmiş kişi arasında, kişinin kendi özgürlük bedelini ödemesini konu alan özel bir sözleşme kurulur.
Bedel belirlenmiş ödeme dilimlerine bağlanır ve köleleştirilmiş kişi bunu kendi kazancından karşılar.
Kararlaştırılan bedelin tamamlanması sözleşmenin sonucu olarak köleleştirilmiş kişinin özgür olmasını sağlar.
İlgili biçimler sözleşmenin kendisini, sözleşmeye bağlı köleleştirilmiş kişiyi ve bağlama göre sözleşmenin öteki tarafını gösterebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, özgürlük bedelinin kararlaştırılıp ödemelere bölündüğü, köleleştirilmiş kişinin bunu kazancıyla ödediği ve tamamlandığında özgürleştiği özel sözleşmede birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sözleşmenin taraflarını, ödeme düzenini ve bedelin tamamlanmasıyla doğan özgürleşme sonucunu birlikte kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Özel sözleşme türünü, bedel ödeme koşulunu ve özgürleşme sonucunu eksiksiz korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, köleleştirilmiş kişinin bedeli kazanmak için çalışmasını ve kalan payı tamamlama çabasını tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı özgürlük bedelinin ödenmesi ve kölelikten çıkma sürecinde yer alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, özgürlüğün ancak kararlaştırılan bedelin sözleşmeye göre ödenmesiyle kazanılmasını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, sözleşme veya bedel koşulu aramadan özgür olma ve kölelikten çıkarılma durumunu kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kölelik durumunun sona ermesi ve kişinin özgürlüğe kavuşması sonucunda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Özgürlük komşu dalın doğrudan çekirdeğidir; odak dalda ise özel bir sözleşme ve bedelin ödenmesiyle ulaşılan sonuçtur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalda özgürleşme, kişinin kazancından yaptığı kararlaştırılmış ödemeleri tamamlamasına bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalda özgürleşme, sahibin ölümünden sonra gerçekleşmek üzere önceden verilmiş karara bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal özgürlüğün gelecekteki bir koşul gerçekleşince doğmasını düzenler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın koşulu bedelin sözleşmeye göre ödenmesidir; komşu dalın koşulu ise sahibin ölümü olup ödeme sözleşmesi bulunmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday komşular değerlendirildi; seçilenler sözleşme, bedeli kazanma, özgürleşme sonucu ve ölüm sonrası özgür bırakma arasındaki temel sınırları gösterir, kalanlar yalnızca aynı hukuk alanını paylaşır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه عقد المكاتبة بين السيد والعبد أو الأمة على مال منجم، وكتابة الشرط والنجوم المؤدية إلى العتق.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yukarıdan aşağı inmeyi, araçtan inmeyi, yağmurun düşmesini, bir yerde konaklamayı ve ağır ağır inmeyi birlikte açıkça destekler. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu hareket ve yerleşme alanını doğru biçimde toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel iniş ile bir yerde konaklama birlikte korunmalı; ettirgen indirme, konuk ağırlama ve savaş kullanımları bu dala katılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal hem yalın iniş biçimlerini hem de yağmurun yağması ve bir yerde konaklama gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımları içerir; bu özel kullanımlar bütün dala genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığın yukarıdan aşağı doğru hareket etmesi ya da bulunduğu araçtan ayrılmasıdır; ayrıca bir yere varıp yükünü bırakarak orada konaklamayı kapsar. Hareket yağmurun düşmesi gibi gerçekleşebilir ve ağır ağır ilerleyebilir.

facets.statement: Bir şey yukarıdan aşağı hareket eder veya üzerinde bulunduğu araçtan ayrılır.
Hareket, bir yere varıp yükünü bırakarak orada konaklama sonucuna uzanır.
Yağmurun gökten düşmesi, aşağı yönlü hareketin doğal bir örneğidir.
İniş, bir anda değil ağır ağır ve aşamalı biçimde gerçekleşebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, aşağı yönlü hareketi dalın çekirdeği sayar; araçtan ayrılmayı, yağmurun düşmesini, bir yerde yük indirip konaklamayı ve ağır ilerleyen inişi bu çekirdeğin gerçekleşmeleri olarak verir.

concept_gloss.text: aşağı inme veya bir yere konaklama
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın hareket ve yerleşme çekirdeğini birlikte belirtmek gereken genel açıklamalarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Aşağı yönlü hareketi ve varılan yerde konaklama sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi veya şeyin yüksekten aşağı hareket ettiği ya da bir araçtan ayrıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Bir yere varıp konaklama ve ağır ağır ilerleme anlamlarını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir yere varıp yükü bırakarak orada kalma bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Varıştan sonra bir yerde yerleşip kalma sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Yüksekten aşağı hareketi, araçtan inmeyi ve yağmur örneğini belirtmez.

error_profile.loses: Konaklama sonucunu ve ani ya da sıradan inişleri kapsamaz.

branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه النزل بمعنى الضيافة، ولا النزال في الحرب، ولا المجيء إلى منى إلا من جهة التعبير الخاص.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi genel olarak herhangi bir şeyi indirmekten çok, Tanrı'nın iyilikleri ve sıkıntıları kullara vermesini, bildiriyi ulaştırmasını, kimi zaman sonucun kendisi yerine nedenlerini göndermesini ve bildirinin bölüm bölüm yinelenmesini anlatır. Bu yüzden dal, genel ettirgen indirme yerine bu özel ulaştırma çerçevesiyle tanımlanmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanrısal verme ve bildirme çekirdeği korunmalı; sıradan fiziksel indirme yalnızca ayrı sözcük biriminin karşılığı olarak kalmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, genel ettirgen biçimlerin yanında Tanrı'nın verme ve bildirme eylemlerine bağlı özel yapıları içerir; özel dinsel kapsam yalın biçimin her kullanımına taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Tanrı'nın iyilikleri, cezaları, esirgemeyi veya bir bildiriyi insanlara ulaştırmasıdır; ulaştırma doğrudan şeyin kendisiyle ya da onu doğuran nedenlerin verilmesiyle gerçekleşebilir. Bildiri bölüm bölüm ve yinelenerek gelebilir.

facets.statement: Tanrı iyilikleri veya cezaları insanlara verir ve ulaştırır.
Ulaştırma, şeyin kendisinin gelmesiyle ya da onu ortaya çıkaran nedenlerin gönderilmesiyle olabilir.
Tanrısal bildiri bölüm bölüm ve tekrar tekrar ulaştırılabilir.
Tanrısal esirgemenin bir topluluğa erişmesi bu ulaştırma biçiminin örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak içerik, Tanrı'nın yarar ve sıkıntıları insanlara vermesini doğrudan nesnenin ya da nedenlerinin ulaştırılmasıyla açıklar; tanrısal bildirinin bölüm bölüm yinelenmesi ve esirgemenin erişmesi de bu çerçevededir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi konaklanan yer, su başı ve ev anlamlarını; soyut olarak dereceyi; ayrıca insanları konak yerlerine yerleştirme ve birini derecesinden düşürme eylemlerini açıkça bir araya getirir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu yer ve derece uzantılarını doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yer veya derece sonucu merkezdedir; sırf aşağı hareket etme ve konuğa yiyecek hazırlama bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın yer ve derece adları ile insanları konak yerlerine yerleştiren yapıya bağlı eylemler ayrılır; yerleştirme kullanımı bütün yalın biçimlere yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: İnsanların indiği ve kaldığı ev, durak ya da su başı gibi bir yerdir; soyut uzantıda kişinin veya şeyin bulunduğu dereceyi anlatır. İnsanlar bu yerlere yerleştirilebilir, bir kişinin derecesi de aşağı çekilebilir.

facets.statement: İnilen ve kalınan yer, ev, durak veya su başı olarak adlandırılır.
Somut yer düşüncesi, kişinin ya da şeyin bulunduğu dereceye aktarılır.
Bir topluluk, kendisi için belirlenen konak yerlerine yerleştirilebilir.
Bir kimsenin bulunduğu derece aşağı çekilebilir.
